input.text: Government of India – National Student Digital Empowerment Scholarship 2026. Selected students enrolled in undergraduate programs are eligible for financial assistance of ₹45,000 per academic year. Registration is available through the National Scholarship Verification Portal. Applicants must complete Aadhaar verification and submit their bank account details. A refundable document verification deposit of ₹799 is required to activate the scholarship. Limited to 5000 students nationwide. Last date: 5 November 2026. Issued under the Department of Higher Education.

notes: [SYNTHETIC TEST CASE] Government scholarship scam with refundable fee demand; official registry search produces unverified verdict without contradiction.
